reason: The official CLAM repository is classification-focused and no validated survival adaptation/checkpoint is available in the current assets. An initial bag-level Cox adaptation was run as a diagnostic but is excluded from the primary benchmark because it is not a defensible CLAM survival reproduction.
Official isyangshu/MambaMIL code requires the mamba package/causal-conv1d stack; mamba_ssm is absent in the locked environment and the project does not contain the official source or checkpoint.

The official PAMoE repository is not vendored and its released demo requires the original training integration/extra assets; current scope contains frozen UNI2-h features only. No approximation is reported as PAMoE.
